name: @activepieces/piece-assemblyai
description: Transcribe and extract data from audio using AssemblyAI's Speech AI.

auth.description: You can retrieve your AssemblyAI API key within your AssemblyAI [Account Settings](https://www.assemblyai.com/app/account?utm_source=activepieces).

uploadFile.name: uploadFile
uploadFile.description: Upload a media file to AssemblyAI's servers.

file.description: The File or URL of the audio or video file.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a local audio or video file to AssemblyAI and returns an upload URL that can be passed to the Transcribe action. Use this when the media is a file (not already a publicly reachable URL) that AssemblyAI must access. Each call uploads a new copy, so it is not idempotent.

transcribe.name: transcribe
transcribe.description: Transcribe an audio or video file using AssemblyAI.

audio_url.description: The URL of the audio or video file to transcribe.

language_code.description:
The language of your audio file. Possible values are found in [Supported Languages](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/concepts/supported-languages).
The default value is 'en_us'.

language_detection.description: Enable [Automatic language detection](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speech-recognition#automatic-language-detection), either true or false.

language_confidence_threshold.description:
The confidence threshold for the automatically detected language.
An error will be returned if the language confidence is below this threshold.
Defaults to 0.

speech_model.description: The speech model to use for the transcription. When `null`, the "best" model is used.

punctuate.description: Enable Automatic Punctuation, can be true or false

format_text.description: Enable Text Formatting, can be true or false

disfluencies.description: Transcribe Filler Words, like "umm", in your media file; can be true or false

dual_channel.description: Enable [Dual Channel](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speech-recognition#dual-channel-transcription) transcription, can be true or false.

webhook_url.description:
The URL to which we send webhook requests.
We sends two different types of webhook requests.
One request when a transcript is completed or failed, and one request when the redacted audio is ready if redact_pii_audio is enabled.

webhook_auth_header_name.description: The header name to be sent with the transcript completed or failed webhook requests

webhook_auth_header_value.description: The header value to send back with the transcript completed or failed webhook requests for added security

auto_highlights.description: Enable Key Phrases, either true or false

audio_start_from.description: The point in time, in milliseconds, to begin transcribing in your media file

audio_end_at.description: The point in time, in milliseconds, to stop transcribing in your media file

word_boost.description: The list of custom vocabulary to boost transcription probability for

boost_param.description: How much to boost specified words

filter_profanity.description: Filter profanity from the transcribed text, can be true or false

redact_pii.description: Redact PII from the transcribed text using the Redact PII model, can be true or false

redact_pii_audio.description: Generate a copy of the original media file with spoken PII "beeped" out, can be true or false. See [PII redaction](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) for more details.

redact_pii_audio_quality.description: Controls the filetype of the audio created by redact_pii_audio. Currently supports mp3 (default) and wav. See [PII redaction](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) for more details.

redact_pii_policies.description: The list of PII Redaction policies to enable. See [PII redaction](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) for more details.

redact_pii_sub.description: The replacement logic for detected PII, can be "entity_type" or "hash". See [PII redaction](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) for more details.

speaker_labels.description: Enable [Speaker diarization](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speaker-diarization), can be true or false

speakers_expected.description: Tells the speaker label model how many speakers it should attempt to identify, up to 10. See [Speaker diarization](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speaker-diarization) for more details.

content_safety.description: Enable [Content Moderation](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/content-moderation), can be true or false

content_safety_confidence.description: The confidence threshold for the Content Moderation model. Values must be between 25 and 100.

iab_categories.description: Enable [Topic Detection](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/topic-detection), can be true or false

sentiment_analysis.description: Enable [Sentiment Analysis](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/sentiment-analysis), can be true or false

auto_chapters.description: Enable [Auto Chapters](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/auto-chapters), can be true or false

entity_detection.description: Enable [Entity Detection](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/entity-detection), can be true or false

speech_threshold.description:
Reject audio files that contain less than this fraction of speech.
Valid values are in the range [0, 1] inclusive.

summarization.description: Enable [Summarization](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/summarization), can be true or false

summary_model.description: The model to summarize the transcript

custom_topics.description: Enable custom topics, either true or false

wait_until_ready.description: Wait until the transcript status is "completed" or "error" before moving on to the next step.

throw_on_error.displayName: Throw if transcript status is error
throw_on_error.description: If the transcript status is "error", throw an error.

aiMetadata.description: Submits an audio or video file (by URL or prior upload) to AssemblyAI for speech-to-text transcription, optionally with extra speech models like speaker diarization, PII redaction, and sentiment. Can either wait synchronously until the transcript is ready or return immediately and continue via webhook (the wait-until-ready and webhook-URL modes are mutually exclusive). Use this to start a new transcription job; each call creates a new transcript, so it is not idempotent.

getTranscript.name: getTranscript
getTranscript.description: Retrieves a transcript by its ID.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single existing transcript by its ID, including its status and transcribed text. Use this to poll or read back a transcript created by the Transcribe action. Requires a valid transcript ID; read-only and idempotent.

getTranscriptSentences.name: getTranscriptSentences
getTranscriptSentences.description: Retrieve the sentences of the transcript by its ID.

aiMetadata.description: Returns the sentence-level segmentation of an existing transcript, identified by its ID, with per-sentence text and timestamps. Use this when you need the transcript broken into sentences rather than the raw text. Requires a valid transcript ID; read-only and idempotent.

getTranscriptParagraphs.name: getTranscriptParagraphs
getTranscriptParagraphs.description: Retrieve the paragraphs of the transcript by its ID.

aiMetadata.description: Returns the paragraph-level segmentation of an existing transcript, identified by its ID, with per-paragraph text and timestamps. Use this when you need the transcript grouped into paragraphs rather than the raw text or individual sentences. Requires a valid transcript ID; read-only and idempotent.

getSubtitles.name: getSubtitles
getSubtitles.description: Export the transcript as SRT or VTT subtitles.

chars_per_caption.description: The maximum number of characters per caption

aiMetadata.description: Exports an existing transcript, identified by its ID, as a subtitle file in either SRT or VTT format (selectable). Use this to produce captions from a completed transcript, optionally capping characters per caption. Requires a valid transcript ID; read-only and idempotent.

getRedactedAudio.name: getRedactedAudio
getRedactedAudio.description: Get the result of the redacted audio model.

download_file_name.description: The desired file name for storing in ActivePieces. Make sure the file extension is correct.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the PII-redacted audio result for an existing transcript by its ID; if redaction is ready it returns the redacted audio URL and can optionally download the file into Activepieces storage. Use this only for transcripts created with PII audio redaction enabled. Requires a valid transcript ID; read-only and idempotent.

wordSearch.name: wordSearch
wordSearch.description: Search through the transcript for keywords. You can search for individual words, numbers, or phrases containing up to five words or numbers.

aiMetadata.description: Searches an existing transcript, identified by its ID, for one or more keywords and returns where each match occurs (individual words, numbers, or short phrases of up to five tokens). Use this to locate specific terms within a completed transcript. Requires a valid transcript ID and a list of search terms; read-only and idempotent.

listTranscripts.name: listTranscripts
listTranscripts.description:
Retrieve a list of transcripts you created.
Transcripts are sorted from newest to oldest. The previous URL always points to a page with older transcripts.

limit.description: Maximum amount of transcripts to retrieve

created_on.description: Only get transcripts created on this date

before_id.description: Get transcripts that were created before this transcript ID

after_id.description: Get transcripts that were created after this transcript ID

throttled_only.description: Only get throttled transcripts, overrides the status filter

aiMetadata.description: Lists transcripts you have created, newest first, with paging support. Use this to discover transcript IDs or browse past transcription jobs when you do not already have a specific ID. Read-only and idempotent.

deleteTranscript.name: deleteTranscript
deleteTranscript.description: Remove the data from the transcript and mark it as deleted.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently removes the data of an existing transcript, identified by its ID, and marks it deleted. Use this to purge a transcript's contents; this is a destructive mutation. Requires a valid transcript ID. Repeating the call after deletion does not restore data, but it changes server state on the first successful call, so it is not idempotent.

lemurTask.name: lemurTask
lemurTask.description: Use the LeMUR task endpoint to input your own LLM prompt.

prompt.description: Your text to prompt the model to produce a desired output, including any context you want to pass into the model.

transcript_ids.description:
A list of completed transcripts with text. Up to a maximum of 100 files or 100 hours, whichever is lower.
Use either transcript_ids or input_text as input into LeMUR.

input_text.description:
Custom formatted transcript data. Maximum size is the context limit of the selected model, which defaults to 100000.
Use either transcript_ids or input_text as input into LeMUR.

context.description: Context to provide the model. This can be a string or a free-form JSON value.

final_model.description: The model that is used for the final prompt after compression is performed.

max_output_size.description: Max output size in tokens, up to 4000

temperature.description:
The temperature to use for the model.
Higher values result in answers that are more creative, lower values are more conservative.
Can be any value between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.

aiMetadata.description: Runs a custom LLM prompt over one or more existing transcripts using AssemblyAI LeMUR, returning the model-generated response. Use this to summarize, answer questions about, or otherwise reason over transcript content with your own prompt. Requires transcript IDs and a prompt; each call invokes the LLM and produces a new request, so it is not idempotent.

getLemurResponse.name: getLemurResponse
getLemurResponse.description: Retrieve a LeMUR response that was previously generated.

request_id.description: The ID of the LeMUR request whose data you want to delete. This would be found in the response of the original request.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a previously generated LeMUR response by its request ID. Use this to read back the result of an earlier LeMUR task without re-running the LLM. Requires a valid LeMUR request ID; read-only and idempotent.

purgeLemurRequestData.name: purgeLemurRequestData
purgeLemurRequestData.description:
Delete the data for a previously submitted LeMUR request.
The LLM response data, as well as any context provided in the original request will be removed.

request_id.description: The ID of the LeMUR request whose data you want to delete. This would be found in the response of the original request.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes the data of a previously submitted LeMUR request, identified by its request ID, including the LLM response and any context from the original request. Use this to purge LeMUR data for privacy or compliance; this is a destructive mutation. Requires a valid LeMUR request ID and is not idempotent.

custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

O valor padrão é 'en_us'.
pt.Enable [Automatic language detection](ht: Habilitar [Detecção de idioma automático](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speech-recognition#automatic-language-detection), verdadeiro ou falso.
pt.The confidence threshold for the automat:
O limite de confiança para o idioma detectado automaticamente.
Um erro será retornado se a confiança do idioma estiver abaixo desse limite.
Padrão é 0.
pt.The speech model to use for the transcri: O modelo de fala a ser usado para a transcrição. Quando `null`, o modelo "best" é usado.
pt.Enable Automatic Punctuation, can be tru: Habilitar Pontuação Automática, pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Enable Text Formatting, can be true or f: Ativar a formatação do texto, pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Transcribe Filler Words, like \"umm\", i: Transcreva Palavras de Filtro, como "umm", no seu arquivo de mídia; pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Enable [Dual Channel](https://www.assemb: Habilitar a transcrição [Canal dual](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speech-recognition#dual-channel-transcription), pode ser verdadeira ou falsa.
pt.The URL to which we send webhook request:
The URL to which we send webhook requests.
We sends two different types of webhook requests.
One request when a transcript is completed or failed, and one request when the redacted audio is ready if redact_pii_audio is enabled.
pt.The header name to be sent with the tran: O nome do cabeçalho a ser enviado com a transcrição concluída ou com solicitações de webhook que falharam
pt.The header value to send back with the t: O valor do cabeçalho para enviar de volta com a transcrição concluída ou com solicitações falhadas de webhook para aumentar a segurança
pt.Enable Key Phrases, either true or false: Ativar frases chave, verdadeiro ou falso
pt.The point in time, in milliseconds, to b: O ponto no tempo, em milissegundos, para começar a transcrever o seu arquivo de mídia
pt.The point in time, in milliseconds, to s: O ponto no tempo, em milissegundos, para parar de transcrever o seu arquivo de mídia
pt.The list of custom vocabulary to boost t: Lista de vocabulário personalizado para aumentar a probabilidade de transcrição de
pt.How much to boost specified words: Quanto para impulsionar as palavras especificadas
pt.Filter profanity from the transcribed te: Filtrar palavrões do texto transcrito, pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Redact PII from the transcribed text usi: Redact PII do texto transcrito usando o modelo de Redact PII pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Generate a copy of the original media fi: Gerar uma cópia do arquivo de mídia original com PII "beeed" falado, pode ser verdadeiro ou falso. Veja [Redação PI](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) para mais detalhes.
pt.Controls the filetype of the audio creat: Controla o tipo de arquivo do áudio criado pelo redact_pii_audio. Atualmente suporta mp3 (padrão) e onda. Veja [PII redaction](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) para mais detalhes.
pt.The list of PII Redaction policies to en: Lista das políticas de Redação PII para habilitar. Veja [PII redaction](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) para mais detalhes.
pt.The replacement logic for detected PII,: A lógica de substituição do PII detectado, pode ser "entity_type" ou "hash". Veja [PII redaction](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/pii-redaction) para mais detalhes.
pt.Enable [Speaker diarization](https://www: Habilitar [Dialização do alto-falante](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speaker-diarization), pode ser verdadeira ou falsa
pt.Tells the speaker label model how many s: Diz ao pregador o modelo de rótulo de quantos pregadores ele deve tentar identificar, até 10. Veja [Dialização do alto-falante](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/speaker-diarization) para mais detalhes.
Habilitar [Moderação de Conteúdo](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/content-moderation), pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.The confidence threshold for the Content: O limite de confiança para o modelo de Moderação de Conteúdo. Os valores devem estar entre 25 e 100.
pt.Enable [Topic Detection](https://www.ass: Habilitar [Detecção de Tópico](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/topic-detection), pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
Habilitar [Análise de Sentimento](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/sentiment-analysis), pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Enable [Auto Chapters](https://www.assem: Ativar [Capítulos Automáticos](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/auto-chapters), pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Enable [Entity Detection](https://www.as: Ativar [Detecção da Entidade](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/entity-detection), pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Reject audio files that contain less tha:
Reject audio files that contain less than this fraction of speech.
Valid values are in the range [0, 1] inclusive.
pt.Enable [Summarization](https://www.assem: Habilitar [Summarization](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/models/summarization), pode ser verdadeiro ou falso
pt.The model to summarize the transcript: O modelo para resumir a transcrição
pt.Enable custom topics, either true or fal: Habilitar tópicos personalizados, verdadeiro ou falso
pt.Wait until the transcript status is \"co: Aguarde até que o status de transcrição seja "completado" ou "erro" antes de passar para o próximo passo.
pt.If the transcript status is \"error\", t: Se o status de transcrição for "erro", lança um erro.
pt.The maximum number of characters per cap: O número máximo de caracteres por legenda
pt.The desired file name for storing in Act: O nome do arquivo desejado para armazenar no ActivePieces. Certifique-se de que a extensão do arquivo está correta.
pt.Maximum amount of transcripts to retriev: Quantidade máxima de transcrições a recuperar
pt.Only get transcripts created on this dat: Apenas obtenha transcrições criadas nesta data
pt.Get transcripts that were created before: Obter transcrições que foram criadas antes desta identificação de transcrição
pt.Get transcripts that were created after: Obter transcrições que foram criadas após esta identificação de transcrição
pt.Only get throttled transcripts, override: Só obter transcrições limitadas, substituir o filtro de status
pt.Your text to prompt the model to produce: Seu texto para prompt o modelo para produzir uma saída desejada, incluindo qualquer contexto que você deseja passar para o modelo.
pt.A list of completed transcripts with tex:
A list of completed transcripts with text. Up to a maximum of 100 files or 100 hours, whichever is lower.
Use either transcript_ids or input_text as input into LeMUR.
pt.Custom formatted transcript data. Maximu:
Custom formatted transcript data. Maximum size is the context limit of the selected model, which defaults to 100000.
Use either transcript_ids or input_text as input into LeMUR.
pt.Context to provide the model. This can b: Contexto para fornecer o modelo. Isto pode ser uma string ou uma forma JSON de forma livre.
pt.The model that is used for the final pro: O modelo que é usado para a prompt final após a compressão é executada.
pt.Max output size in tokens, up to 4000: Tamanho máximo de saída em tokens, até 4000
pt.The temperature to use for the model.\nH:
A temperatura para usar para o modelo.
Valores maiores resultam em respostas que são mais criativas, valores mais baixos são mais conservadores.
Pode ser qualquer valor entre 0.0 e 1.0 inclusive.
pt.The ID of the LeMUR request whose data y: O ID da solicitação LeMUR cujos dados você deseja excluir. Isto pode ser encontrado na resposta da solicitação original.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
pt.US Social Security Number: Número de Segurança Social dos EUA
